column3: Vejeeta is the prince of the Sayans, a warrior race. Born elite. Goku is a Sayan too. But he was sent away as a baby, because his power was so low.
Vejeeta's people wear a device called a scouter. It turns a person into a number. When Goku powers up, Vejeeta reads it, and crushes the scouter in his fist.
One on one, Vejeeta is stronger. It takes four fighters together to bring him down. He still calls it his first great humiliation.
Then Goku becomes the legendary Super Sayan first. The one thing Vejeeta believed was his birthright.
So he trains alone, at four hundred and fifty times normal gravity, living every day to pass him. And he transforms too. Out of fury at himself, for being second.
